content: Current official CFO and CRO-MG material requires current professional identification, formal patient-image authorization, responsible-professional attribution, and no procedure-in-progress or result-promise content. CRO-MG says specialty advertising requires registered specialty. CFO reports an August 19 2026 TRF1 panel decision annulling Resolution 198/2019 while stating it will contest the decision; no case-specific release conclusion can be inferred.
